title: Endive Spear Micro Salads - Blue Cheese, Pear And Pecan Endive Micro Salad

ingredientSections.heading: Candied Pecans
items: ¼ Cup cane or coconut sugar

ingredientSections.heading: Dijon Balsamic Dressing
items: 3 tsp Orchard Pear & Pinot Noir Preserves
Ground salt and pepper to taste

methodSections.heading: Candied Pecans
steps: Lay some parchment paper on a tray and set aside. Add the pecans, butter and sugar to a frying pan over the medium high heat. Stirring regularly and watching closely, cook until the butter and sugar have melted and coated the pecans.
Remove from the pan onto the parchment and, working quickly, spread the nuts out so they don’t stick to each other. Allow to cool and then roughly chop.

methodSections.heading: Dijon Balsamic Dressing
steps: Whisk all of the ingredients together except the olive oil and salt and pepper. Slowly add the olive oil bit by bit while continuing to whisk. Season to taste.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: Dice the pears and toss in the dressing to taste. Arrange the endive spears so they are ready to fill.
Combine the pears, pecans and blue cheese in a bowl. Spoon this filling mixture into the endive spears. Serve with the preserve on the side.
